comment_regular: AnimSequenceMultiple vtable +0x10. Consumes a signed selector byte: 0..127 can select exactly; 0x80..0xFE sign-extend and fail the unsigned count bound, while 0xFF is explicit random. ActorAnimData_LoadState intercepts serialized 0xFE before this virtual, so 0xFE is a null-sequence marker in save files rather than random restore.
